proof_constraints: Use exact declared repository/commit/path, and compare Git tree Cargo.toml blob SHA1 with the complete authenticated Cargo.toml.orig Git-blob SHA1 retained here; a SHA256 file digest is not a Git blob ID.
Require nontruncated/unmodified complete manifest for this local Git-blob proof. A captured prefix alone cannot establish the full Git blob, even though its full archive-member SHA256 is known.

All3 selected VCS records omit dirty rather than explicitlyfalse; describe them as not marked dirty unless pinned Cargo producer semantics are separately established. Dirtytrue, unknown inherited versions or mismatched manifest/tree stay UNRESOLVED.

Same-commit root license files must contain actual complete grants/conditions/disclaimers and applicable attribution, agree with declared SPDX and cover the named subcrate without contrary local exceptions; retain exact path/bytes/SHA256 and Git-tree identity.

A scoped missing-notice association does not prove every crate file equals that upstream tree, original.crate authenticity, all-files coverage, compiler/binary correspondence, legal/relinking acceptance or release eligibility.

All3 targets occur in root Cargo.lock and none in the Cargo-tool lock; locks/purpose descriptions establish declared source membership only. Dependency edges,target cfg,features and actual Linux host/build selection were not resolved or executed.

Absence from the two captured lock declarations is not proof of an unused component: other workspace/tool locks were not evaluated. Linux-specific API descriptions do not establish AArch64/M2 compatibility or execution.
